sources.snippet: Lodestones releases Kroma v0.2 as a full Krea 2 fine-tuned checkpoint instead of a LoRA, with base and turbo files plus community INT8 quants for ComfyUI.

sources.title: Kroma - v0.2 KREA 2 - Free AI CHECKPOINT | TensorHub Art
sources.snippet: Provenance v0.2 was produced by continued full fine-tuning of the K2 (Krea 2) checkpoint behind Kroma v0.1 — without the rank-256 LoRA delta compression used for the v0.1 release — followed by merging the Krea 2 Turbo delta in as a rank-512 LoRA.
